text_block_list.text:
"I decided to let the exhausted Agnes 
Tachyon rest in the infirmary."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Phew... Fatigue is truly a troublesome 
thing."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, I'll take you up on that. Please wake 
me when it's a good time."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Good night, Trainer-kun.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hmm...? Where on earth is this...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
What an expansive space. And this air... 
is remarkably clear.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...Could this situation possibly be a 
dream?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case... I suppose this is 
what they call a lucid dream. Hmm, how 
fascinating.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
In other words, within a dream, wouldn't 
any impossibility become possible?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
For example, speed beyond all limits... 
You could simulate that experience!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
If doing so allows me to bring those 
sensations and knowledge back into the 
real world...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
This is bound to be a wonderful 
discovery!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Alright, why don't we try all sorts of 
things!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hah...! I am... I see, I've awakened...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh... Upon awakening, my senses were 
somewhat uncertain, but—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
What exhilaration! Magnificent! This will 
surely prove invaluable for my future 
research...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun, Trainer-kun, are you there!? 
You've got to hear this!

It seems she had quite a good dream. I 
didn't really understand her explanation, 
but seeing her cheered up is what matters 
most.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: It should... be...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Guh...! To realize it was a lucid dream, 
yet wake up without having done a single 
thing!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Aw, that's too cruel~. Lemme sleep just a 
little longer~.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Haaaah... I feel like a feast was served 
to me, only to be thrown in the trash 
right before my eyes...
